injuries.name: Quinn Hughes
injuries.note: A timeline for Hughes' return remains unclear, but he won't play against Vancouver on Saturday and will miss Monday's matchup against San Jose. He has posted eight goals, 34 points, 63 shots on net and 19 blocked shots in 24 appearances this season.

injuries.name: Filip Gustavsson
injuries.note: Gustavsson will see his first action since May 5 against the Avalanche in the playoffs last year. Look for the netminder to start at least one of two games against AHL San Diego on Friday and Saturday, if not both contests. Once given the all-clear, Gustavsson will likely slot into the No. 2 role behind Jesper Wallstedt, which could see Calvin Pickard shifted to the minors.

injuries.name: Elias Pettersson
injuries.note: Pettersson has already been ruled out for Saturday's matchup against Minnesota, and the Canucks will be cautious with the 28-year-old forward. It's still unclear when he will be ready to return. Pettersson has provided six goals, 23 points, 30 shots on net, 32 blocked shots and 41 hits in 24 appearances this season.

injuries.name: Brendan Gallagher
injuries.note: Gallagher will miss at least the next three games, starting with Saturday's matchup against Minnesota, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return. He has collected three assists, 26 shots on net, eight blocked shots and 32 hits in 21 appearances this campaign.

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.note: Demko missed the second half of the 2025-26 season after undergoing hip surgery in January, and he was officially placed on injured reserve last week. He doesn't yet have a clear timetable for when he'll be back in action, but Sedin said that Demko is "taking steps every day" in his recovery process. While Demko is sidelined, Kevin Lankinen and Leevi Merilainen should compete for starts in the Canucks' crease.

injuries.name: Filip Gustavsson
injuries.note: Hip: The Minnesota Wild sent Gustavsson to the minors on Thursday (Nov. 19) for a conditioning stint.

injuries.name: Quinn Hughes
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Wild said on Saturday (Nov. 21) that Hughes will miss the team's road trip, per Joe Smith of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Olli Maatta
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Minnesota Wild placed D Olli Maatta on injured reserve on Monday (Nov. 16).

injuries.name: Guillaume Brisebois
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Vancouver Canucks placed D Guillaume Brisebois on injured reserve on Friday (Nov. 13).

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.note: Hip: The Canucks placed Demko on injured reserve and hopeful he will be ready to return before Christmas, per Kevin Woodley of NHL.com.

injuries.name: Brendan Gallagher
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Vancouver Canucks placed F Brendan Gallagher on injured reserve on Saturday (Nov. 21).

injuries.name: Mackenzie MacEachern
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Vancouver Canucks placed F Mackenzie MacEachern on injured reserve non-roster.

injuries.name: Elias Pettersson
injuries.note: Upper Body: Pettersson isn't expected to play against Chicago on Sunday (Nov. 22), per Canucks play-by-play announcer Brendan Batchelor.
